taxon.wikipedia_summary: Allium longispathum, the Mediterranean onion, is a species of flowering plant in the family Amaryllidaceae, native to Macaronesia and the Mediterranean basin. Some authorities consider it a subspecies of pale garlic, Allium paniculatum.
